# CrossTask

Instructional tasks with step descriptions and primary-task temporal annotations.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** A video prefix for a primary task and its completed step sequence.

**Output / label:** Future steps completing the same procedure.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://github.com/DmZhukov/CrossTask)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://github.com/DmZhukov/CrossTask), [planning_paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.15130)

## Intention in this dataset

Forecast remaining primary-task steps under the cited procedure planning setup. A task description defines a prescribed process rather than a private human goal.

**Relevance:** `implicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2019

**Domains:** daily_activities, human_object_interaction  
**Intention types:** action, task_goal  
**Tasks:** future_activity_prediction  
**Modalities:** rgb, audio, text  
**Formats:** video, text, structured_annotation

## Limits and notes

The original collection has 18 primary and 65 related tasks. Related-task videos do not have the same manual step annotations; downstream subsets require separate protocol mapping.
